diagnosis.what_happened: Headings aligned left, tables had schema errors, and acronyms remained English.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Injecting w:jc w:val='right' with w:bidi=1 caused left alignment inversion. bidiVisual appended at the end of tblPr violated schema. Narrative lacked w:jc w:val='both'. Acronyms were skipped.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Omit w:jc when w:bidi=1. Apply w:jc w:val='both' to narrative text. Translate acronyms. Insert bidiVisual as first child of tblPr.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML specifies bidi logic where explicit right alignment reverses trailing edges. Strict schema specifies bidiVisual must precede tblW.

desired_behavior: Do not inject <w:jc w:val='right'/> under <w:bidi w:val='1'/>; strip existing ones (Supersedes LSN-2026-EXPLICIT-RIGHT-ALIGNMENT). Use tblPr.insert(0, bidi) for bidiVisual. Ensure narrative paragraphs have <w:jc w:val='both'/>. Translate English acronyms (e.g. IUS, SCI) in tables.
generalization: OpenXML Bidi requires zero right-alignment tags for RTL, specific element ordering, and explicit justification for narrative.
